notes.squint: 1/16 BOX downscale + 1 px blur, luma; loud = share of 16 px cells above 0.38; lit_vs_dim = mean luma of lit cells / dim cells
notes.hover_vs_marks: hover marks (corners, PLAN arrows, pencil, bursts), ghosts and insets vs digits, labels, tags, badges, tickets, leader, tape, plates, hand and (O-30) hud_labels: 0 px required
notes.hud_labels: O-30: every HUD word box (hud2.txt / obj2.txt) is an occluder class; pencil rings are fitted (hz_core.fit_oval) until they touch none
notes.lift: O-30: the lifted card alone keeps >= 4 px outside r455 and >= 3 px from every landing mark; search over lift scale, lift height and fan slide
notes.pixel_dot_runs: O-30: dot_audit.py on the rendered pixels (runs of 5+ evenly spaced small spots); 0 required
notes.units_arcs: hover over units and arcs is reported as info (hover_over_units_arcs_px_info), since corners and arrows sit on cells by design
